title: artemisia vulgaris subsp. typica
intro: Artemisia vulgaris subsp. typica, commonly known as common wormwood, is a subspecies of the wormwood plant. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve menstrual cramps, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of common wormwood are attributed to its antiseptic, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it effective in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Artemisia vulgaris subsp. typica include artemisinin, thujone, and borneol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
